notes: Nodes are implicit: every entry id in frameworks/*.json is a node, and an id with no incoming edge has no prerequisites. Edge = { from: prerequisite id, to: dependent id, reason, strength }. hard: the scheduler must not introduce `to` while `from` is still untaught. soft: ordering preference only, never blocks. The union of hard and soft edges must stay acyclic. Evidence, semantics and open owner questions: docs/framework-prereqs-proposal.md.
